description:
Looking for the advantages of disc brakes, more tire clearance than rim brakes, but want the simplicity and higher compatibility of traditional cable routing. The Santa Rosa Disc, will provide exactly that. With it's T47 BB, 700x32 tire clearance and disc brakes, you will have all you need.

Handcrafted with precision in El Retiro, Colombia, we meticulously build each in-house Santa Rosa frameset using the finest materials and techniques. This one-by-one approach ensures that every bike is custom-tuned to match your riding style and requirements, delivering unparalleled ride quality, durability, and performance.

"The Santa Rosa was born to prove that steel is as relevant as ever. That a steel bike can be fast, reactive, and aggressive while maintaining the buttery smoothness the material is known for. More than just a frameset, the Santa Rosa is a stamp in time - a reminder that steel has been, is, and will always be a material capable of creating some of the most incredible machines on the planet."

components.description: Wolf Tooth headset matching the specs of the selected variant.
Built with oversized-ovalized main tubing and short tapered chain stays that prove to be our fastest and most reactive road platform.
Every frameset comes with a small set of touchup paint and framesaver.
